name: Nanase Nozomi
source:
She is a student at an all-girls school in Tokyo. She is not a member of any club, but is athletic.

Because of this, she is often seen as an active girl and acts as such, but secretly she wants to be like a feminine woman like her sister, Yumi.

She is a girl who has intense emotional ups and downs and appears to be a masculine, but she really thinks that her future dream is to become a bride.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/choumanin2/index.html]official site[/url]]
